function: Learned (DRL) joint allocation of LEO-to-HAP transmit power and bandwidth, onboard computing and semantic symbol selection to maximize QoSem for image transmission in an NTN downlink (p. 10).
system: Single LEO satellite at 800 km to five HAPs, OFDMA downlink, 30 GHz, scalar LoS channel; antenna array and RIS not mentioned (pp. 7, 14, 15).
method: Mixed-action soft actor-critic (continuous SAC for power and bandwidth, discrete SAC for semantic selection and computing), reinforcement learning; ViT semantic codec updated by gradient descent (pp. 8, 11).
data_channel: 3GPP TR 38.811 NTN path loss with shadow fading, ITU atmospheric attenuation, LoS channel (pp. 4, 7); AWGN for image metrics (p. 17); CIFAR-100 and Kodak24 images (pp. 14-15).
test_conditions: No separate test conditions stated: 500 training episodes (Fig. 4, p. 15); sweeps of bandwidth, power, data size, SNR and QoSem weights on CIFAR-100 and Kodak24 (pp. 15-18).
baselines: SAC-based Random-SIS and ORA-SC, SAC-based EPBA-SC (equal power and bandwidth), T-H SAC-TODT (hybrid SAC, non-semantic transmission); all SAC-based, none earlier published (p. 14).
metrics: QoSem, average reward, PSNR, SSIM, total consumption time, semantic rate, computing resource consumption, power and bandwidth usage (pp. 15-19).
complexity: Order O(Tel Eep Nneuron Llayer (Mactor + Mcritic)) plus ViT and fully connected layer terms, Eq. (37); no measured runtime or FLOPs (p. 14).
q1_support: p. 4: "We adopt the NTN channel model stipulated by the 3GPP in TR 38.811"; p. 14: "The FSPL model, channel model and other parameters for the LEO satellite are given in [6], [8]".
q2_support: p. 15: "was adopted to evaluate our approach across several datasets". Not met: the paper never says that training excluded Kodak24 or that the agent was not retrained; the other tests sweep SNR (p. 17), bandwidth and power (p. 16), which do not count.
q3_support: p. 14: "we compared it to three benchmarks"; p. 14: "Only semantic information is optimized by MADIS-SAC, while bandwidth and power are allocated equally". Not met: all three benchmarks are SAC-based variants of the proposed method; no purely non-learned method and no earlier published learned method is compared.
q4_support: p. 14: "the overall computational complexity of the proposed algorithm is approximated by (37)", where Eq. (37) gives the order O(Tel Eep Nneuron Llayer (...)).
q5_support: p. 14: "CIFAR-100 dataset [48] consisting of 100 classes"; p. 15: "the Kodak24 dataset [49]". Not met: both are public image sets of the learning task, not channel data; the channel is simulated (p. 4) and no code or data link is given.
notes: Included as area 6: the SAC agent controls LEO-to-HAP transmit power and bandwidth jointly with semantic symbol selection and computing allocation (p. 10), which is physical-layer control of a satellite link, and NTN works admit a single-antenna link. The semantic codec is a pretrained T2T-ViT (p. 5) and is not the learned function graded. Doubts for the reviewer. q1: the text names TR 38.811 (p. 4) but reference [6] is listed as TR 38.821 (p. 20), the model used is path loss, shadow fading, ITU attenuation and a LoS-only coefficient (pp. 4, 7), and image metrics use AWGN (p. 17). q2: Kodak24 may be an unseen dataset (p. 15), but the paper does not say so.
